description: One lot that went into another lot. THE TRANSFORMATION EDGE, AND THE ONLY REASON A TRACE IS EVER MORE THAN ONE HOP: a pack line that combines four field lots into a pallet code has destroyed the join unless somebody wrote down which four, and nobody can reconstruct it afterwards from weights. Read forwards it says where a block's fruit ended up; read backwards it says which blocks are in a pallet a buyer is holding.

fields.description: The input lot. A Link to Traceability Lot Code rather than a typed code, because this edge is the whole graph — a typo here is a pallet whose blocks cannot be found, and it is invisible on the form where the wrong code looks exactly like the right one.
fields.label: Source Lot

fields.description: The input lot's block, snapshotted when the edge was written. Denormalised for the reason every name in this app is: the source lot can be corrected, merged or re-graded afterwards, and a pallet read two years later is entitled to the block this app believed it came from at the moment somebody combined it. `trace_lot_backward` walks the Link, not this — it is evidence, not the join.
fields.label: Source Field

fields.description: How much of the source lot went in, where anybody measured it. ZERO AND BLANK ARE DIFFERENT ANSWERS: blank is 'this lot is in the pallet and nobody weighed the share', which is honest and still traceable; a share invented by dividing the pallet evenly would be a number nobody measured, and a recall scoped by it would be wrong in both directions.
fields.label: Quantity Contributed

fields.description: The unit the contribution is in — bins, lb, boxes. Kept per row rather than taken from the parent, because a repack genuinely combines lots counted in different units and forcing one would make somebody convert on the spot and record the conversion instead of the count.
fields.label: Quantity UOM

fields.description: Why this lot is in this one, where it is not obvious — a partial pallet topped up from the next row, a re-grade, fruit pulled back off a truck.
fields.label: Note

name: Traceability Lot Source
